verdict.rationale: DeepInfra documents a first-party zero retention policy that keeps inputs, outputs, and user data private, backed by SOC 2 and ISO 27001 certification. It also offers dedicated instances for data isolation. That strongly implies data cannot be used for training, but the pack never explicitly says customer data is excluded from model training. missing for 10: explicit no-training commitment, detailed policy/terms documentation, independent corroboration of retention/training practices.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models

citations.quote: With our zero retention policy your inputs, your outputs, and your user data stay private. DeepInfra is SOC 2 and ISO 27001 certified.
require data isolation? Deploy a dedicated instance on A100/H100/H200/B200/B300 with autoscaling and a private endpoint
